sections.Profile:
"City Slicker" is a pinball machine released by Bally in March 1987. The game features a theme based on Americana and mafia influences, with five flippers, one ramp, and a two-ball multiball mode. It was designed by Greg Kmiec, with artwork by Pat McMahon and sound by M. Bartlow. Only 300 units were produced.
